# Context Usage for Google Antigravity

A lightweight, 100% local **Google Antigravity** plugin providing a **Live Context Usage Side Panel** in the Auxiliary Pane plus an inline **`/context-usage`** slash command.

Monitor active context window tokens, category breakdowns, prompt cache hit rates, `/compact` checkpoints, and turn-by-turn context growth in real time—with **zero extra LLM calls** in the side panel (`<10 ms` cold parse, `<0.2 ms` cached poll).

---

## Features

- **Live Auxiliary Side Panel (`Context Usage`)**
  - **Real-Time Gauge**: Active tokens against `Auto` (`200k` -> `1M`), `200k`, or `1M` window scales, remaining capacity, in-flight pending token estimates, and `/compact` alerts at 70% / 85%.
  - **Stacked Category Breakdown**: Visual share of `System / Rules / Tools`, `Summary / Agent` (or `Agent & Thinking`), `Tool Outputs`, and `User Messages`.
  - **Session Telemetry**: Prompt cache hit rate (`cached` vs. `new` tokens), `/compact` checkpoint count, model step count, and cumulative session I/O.
  - **Turn History Sparkline**: Interactive SVG chart across recent turns with compaction markers and hover inspection.
  - **Auto-Follow & Session Switcher**: Automatically tracks the active workspace conversation even when opened directly from the Auxiliary Pane switcher, with a header dropdown to switch across recent chats or preview a new conversation.
  - **Native Theme Sync**: Automatically adapts to Antigravity Light and Dark themes.
- **Inline Slash Command (`/context-usage [200k | 1m]`)**
  - Precomputed locally in ~30 ms via a `PreInvocation` hook (`context_stats.py`) and rendered as an aligned monospace `[████░░░░]` progress block across Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, and `agy` CLI.

---

## Installation

### Option 1: Antigravity CLI (`agy`)

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/iamorozov/antigravity-context-usage
```

### Option 2: Clone Directly (Global Machine Config)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/iamorozov/antigravity-context-usage ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-usage
```

### Option 3: Workspace-Scoped (Shared with a Team Repo)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/iamorozov/antigravity-context-usage .agents/plugins/context-usage
```

---

## Usage

### Side Panel
- Open **Context Usage** from the Auxiliary Pane switcher in Antigravity, or ask the agent to open the Context Usage panel (`[Context Usage](sidecar://context-usage/panel/)`).
- Switch scales anytime using the **`Auto` / `200k` / `1M`** toggle in the panel header.

### Slash Command
Type any of the following in chat:
- `/context-usage` — Auto-scales (`200k` up to 200k tokens, `1M` above 200k)
- `/context-usage 200k` — Pin bar to the 200k compaction threshold
- `/context-usage 1m` — Pin bar to the full 1M context window

---

## Privacy & Requirements

- **100% Local & Read-Only**: Reads only local Antigravity session transcripts (`<appData>/brain/<conversationId>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`). Makes zero external network requests and never modifies session state.
- **Runtime Requirements**:
  - **Node.js 18+** (for the `sidecar_sdk` Auxiliary Pane web UI)
  - **Python 3.9+** standard library only (for the `/context-usage` `PreInvocation` hook)

---

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)
